title: Call Center

Combine IP phones, VoIP gateways, dialers, and headsets with call management capabilities for domestic and international operations.

title: Industry Solution
intro: Different industries need different technologies, infrastructure, and collaboration workflows. Dinstar India offers communication solutions designed around those needs, with deployment, management, and personnel training in mind.
Plan a scalable setup for enterprise offices, healthcare, education, or hospitality, matching the solution to how your people work.
